summary: Cinematic platformer entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Another World
entries.definitive_edition: 20th Anniversary Edition on PC, with original/enhanced toggles documented

emulation.emulator: WinUAE / DOSBox only for original-version comparison
emulation.notes: Use native Anniversary Edition for primary.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Amiga/DOS version for historical comparison; PC Anniversary for current access

primary.why: Another World has many ports, and the 20th Anniversary Edition is the easiest current route with modern display options while preserving the classic cinematic platformer. The Amiga/DOS originals matter for exact historical fidelity and should be compared if the archive wants original timing/presentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the 20th Anniversary Edition on PC. Record storefront/build, original vs enhanced graphics/audio toggles, controller, display settings, and whether an Amiga/DOS original was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if documenting exact launch-era fidelity.
secondary.why: The anniversary edition is convenient, but original computer versions are the historical artifact.

all_releases.platform: Amiga / Atari ST / DOS and early computer/console ports
all_releases.fidelity: Original release family with platform-specific presentation differences.

all_releases.platform: 15th / 20th Anniversary Edition on PC and later platforms
all_releases.fidelity: Modern rerelease with original/enhanced presentation options.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Modern Anniversary Edition access and original computer-version fidelity are not identical.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record graphics/audio mode, display settings, and whether original computer timing was compared.
